1647.body:
The prize money on "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" leans toward small, frequent prizes. It is spread over thirteen prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $15 million. The second-biggest prize left on "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" is $1 million, with four of them remaining.

Everything here about "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" comes from official Florida lottery numbers, current through October 8.
